“Ellie,” a devoted novel reader, unexpectedly finds herself in the body of the heroine's friend in her favorite novel. At first, she was overjoyed, as she extremely adored the heroine.
But then everything turned upside down!
Ellie soon realized that “Nara,” the supposedly sweet friend, was not as good as she seemed.
The backyard plants were stolen by someone she trusted.
The botanic power that should have flourished was suppressed, all because of the devious plans of this so-called best friend.
The harsh truth kept coming at her relentlessly.
Ding!
“Morning Glory, Level 0.
Action Panel:
Option 1: Absorb Botanic Power.
Option 2: Transfer Botanic Power......”
Suddenly, a message from a system appeared before her.
Did she gain a golden finger ability?
In that case, all the challenges ahead would no longer be a problem for Ellie!
tome-of-troubled-times:
A young man plagued by recurring nightmares finds himself visiting a blind fortune teller, who sends him to a world of martial arts that looks a lot like the wuxia stories he used to read.
In the sky of this world, a tome shines every now and then, revealing the hierarchy of mighty beings that seek power amid troubled times. Determined to unravel the mysteries of his involuntary journey and the secrets of the world he has ended up in, he endeavors to ascend the tome’s rankings, all while looking for a path back home.
Official Chinese blurb
Wandering the jianghu with a blade and wine, where beauties’ grace is filling one’s mind.
A youth, saber on his back and wine gourd at the waist, strides forth, yet the jianghu of his heart seems only more elusive;
With each flipped page of the Tome of Troubled Times, decades of nights soaked in rain pass over the jianghu.
As he suddenly turns to look back, he finds that the mortal world has shattered in his wake.
unparalleled-evolution-i-became-the-lord:
[Special Legacy has been discovered. Granting ultimate authority.]
---
When the Apocalypse struck, the greatest invention of humanity was released — The Humanity System.
Every teenager between the ages of 17 and 20, has a chance to absorb energy and undergo evolution.
Some evolved through the speed path, making them 100 times faster than sound. Some evolved through the strength path, granting them the power to shatter meteors. Some evolved through sight path, granting them an insane processing ability to slow down time.
But Valen evolved through… nothing.
Initially regarded as the greatest genius after his father, Valen failed to undergo evolution for three straight years. Tagged as a failure and mocked for being a faded prodigy, he was soon forgotten by society, meant to rot away in mediocrity.
However, Valen never expected to undergo sudden evolution, and it did not occur through one or two paths, but through all of them! And he evolved the strongest path ever recorded in human history.

you-are-my-starlight: Mianmian felt that the last 20 years of her life was a big tragedy. Her father didn’t love her and her stepmother only pretended to treat her well. She only wanted to work and study hard so that she could leave the house after saving enough money, but ended up being harmed by her so-called family. However, Su Mianmian never thought that the seemingly dark and bottomless abyss was actually her starlight of salvation.
zombie-bodyguard:
Who said zombies are stiff-limbed and fear the sunlight? After becoming a zombie, Lin Tian was impervious to blades and bullets, and could move freely and sunbathe.
He kept a low profile as a zombie, but took on a high-profile role as a bodyguard.
